title: RICHFISH unified fishing locations — verified available sources

google_takeout_fishing_list.note: The 64 entries belong to the separately saved boat launch list; 55 fishing entries in the named Fishing Spots.csv

rules: Every user-provided coordinate is preserved even within the same site
Parent links are conservative and may be provisional
Regional anchor coordinates are not precise casting points
Access and regulations unverified unless specifically sourced
No catch sightings are inferred from pins
Fish Scale scoring is not generated without observations
